# IATA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v5) with a 12-month target of Rp110.0 against Rp71.0 (expected total return 55.4%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- FY2027E volume of 6.5 Mt is +78% on FY2026E 3.65 Mt and +86% on the 2026 run-rate (~3.4 Mt). The 7.85 Mt figure is a pending RKAB request - S8 p.32 states approval was 'masih belum diperoleh' at the annual-report date - 
- The bear (0.8 x 6.5 = 5.2 Mt) is a solvency tail at Rp8, but 5.2 Mt is still +42% on FY2026E 3.65 Mt. No scenario has volume flat at ~3.6-4.2 Mt with a clean refinancing; on the model's own near-linear unit economics 3.6
- The bridge charges Rp1.03/share, from a 10% share issue at Rp60 raising USD10.4m, for a liquidity gap of at least USD15.2m (current liabilities 77.35 vs current assets 62.13 [F60/F59]) plus the matured Series B [S12 Note

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
